arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Ross argued Section 6330 creates a levy-specific exception to the pay-first rule.
Mr. Dvoretzky argued the IRS cannot evade jurisdiction by keeping taxpayer money through offsets.
Ms. Rose noted the statute allows applying overpayments as credits.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The dispute centers on whether the IRS can use discretionary offsets to remove a case from Tax Court jurisdiction. The taxpayer argues this practice evades statutory review of liability determinations.
